bugs.description: The table no longer includes the zero-attempt boundary, which is the only branch that must return immediately.
bugs.reachablePreconditions: A retry begins at attempt zero and a later implementation changes or removes the special-case branch.
bugs.observableImpact: The suite can pass while first-attempt operations are unnecessarily delayed, increasing latency for every retried operation.
bugs.provenance: Seeded table-case deletion; the base and head subtest inventories provide deterministic evidence that the boundary scenario disappeared.
